nfl.oneThing: The Steelers responded to a turbulent week by beating the Broncos 27–5 on Black Friday, their first game since they waived Aaron Rodgers. The win moved them to 7–4.

headlines.title: Steelers beat Broncos 27–5 in first game after Rodgers exit
headlines.summary: Pittsburgh won its first game since waiving Aaron Rodgers, who had gone on The Pat McAfee Show and criticised head coach Mike McCarthy. Players said a leadership council meeting earlier in the week had aired grievances and aimed to keep the team together. T.J. Watt and Cam Heyward were credited for steadying the group. Rodgers later claimed he had been barred from the Steelers' facility. The Steelers are now 7–4 and unbeaten at home this season.
headlines.whyItMatters: The win keeps Pittsburgh at No. 6 in the AFC, but the off-field noise is the bigger test for the rest of the season.

headlines.title: Brock Purdy out for 49ers against Seahawks with mid-ankle sprain
headlines.summary: Brock Purdy has been ruled out for Sunday's NFC West game against the Seahawks. He hurt his left ankle in the second quarter of the 35–10 win over the Vikings and did not practise all week. Shanahan says it is a mid-ankle sprain, which is slower to heal than a low sprain, and that Purdy will not need surgery. Mac Jones starts at home with Kurtis Rourke as backup. Seattle comes in at 6–4, and a loss would make a playoff run in the division very hard. Shanahan is optimistic about Purdy returning for the Rams game the following week but says it is too soon to say.
headlines.whyItMatters: The 49ers are the NFL's best at 9–1, so the division lead is secure for now, but a win over Seattle would give them a clear edge over a team it has to chase.

headlines.title: DJ Uiagalelei to start for Chargers as Justin Herbert sits with concussion
headlines.summary: Justin Herbert remains in concussion protocol and has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots. DJ Uiagalelei will make his first NFL start, and it will come against Tommy DeVito and New England. The Chargers are 1–9 and their offence has struggled all season. Coach Jim Harbaugh confirmed the decision on Friday.
headlines.whyItMatters: With the Chargers at 1–9, the start is more about development than the standings, but the offence has little margin for error.

headlines.title: Bills have multiple paths to the AFC's No. 1 seed
headlines.summary: Buffalo beat the Chiefs 13–10 on Thursday night to make it 10–1. The Bills sit at No. 1 in the AFC, a game clear of Denver at 8–3, and the Broncos' loss to Pittsburgh helped open the way. Josh Allen threw two interceptions in the win, while James Cook ran for 117 yards and a touchdown.
headlines.whyItMatters: A top seed gives Buffalo a home playoff game and a bye, which is why Yahoo Sports says the path to it is clearer after Denver's loss.

teamNews.title: Brock Bowers questionable for Sunday night in Cleveland
teamNews.text: Bowers missed practice on Friday after being limited Wednesday and Thursday. Kubiak says the team is doing everything it can to get him ready. Bowers has missed three games this season, and the Review-Journal reports he is still the team's leader in receiving yards and touchdowns. He has been down in recent form, averaging 5.2 catches and 72.8 yards over the last five games, against 6.3 and 84.5 for the season.

teamNews.title: Defensive tackles and guard ruled out
teamNews.text: Tim Keenan III (knee), Adam Butler (concussion) and Tonka Hemingway (stinger) have all been ruled out for the Browns game. Jackson Powers-Johnson has been ruled out with an Achilles injury, which Central Oregon Daily described as potentially significant. The Raiders also designated linebacker Patrick Johnson to return from injured reserve.

teamNews.title: Special teams a concern after Denver
teamNews.text: Two punts were deflected in the loss to the Broncos in Week 11, and the coaches have said they need to fix that before Cleveland. The Raiders lost 24–38 at Denver.

contextCard.title: How injured reserve works
contextCard.body: A player placed on injured reserve has to sit out a minimum period before he can come back. Teams can also designate players to return from injured reserve, which opens a window for them to rejoin the active roster. That is why a player can be listed as designated to return before he is fully active again.

nba.oneThing: The Pistons, 76ers and Mavericks are through to the NBA Cup knockout round. The Knicks were eliminated after the Heat beat them 108–105.

headlines.title: Pistons, 76ers and Mavericks through to NBA Cup knockouts
headlines.summary: Dallas had already clinched a berth coming into the final night of group play. Detroit followed with a 113–98 win over Milwaukee, finishing 3–1 with the best point differential in East Group A. Philadelphia beat Indiana 111–87 to take East Group B on tiebreaker over Miami. The Knicks needed to win by at least seven and have the 76ers lose, but Miami beat them 108–105 and they went out. Detroit will host a knockout-round game and could finish as the East's top seed.
headlines.whyItMatters: Detroit and Philadelphia are already in the knockout round, and the Pistons' home game gives them a shot at the East's top seed in the tournament.

headlines.title: Steph Curry out at least three more games with oblique tear
headlines.summary: Golden State has ruled Curry out for its next three games, extending his absence from a torn oblique that he suffered on November 11. He has missed the last six games, and the Warriors have gone 2–4 in that stretch. The team says he is making progress and has started individual on-court work, but there is no firm return date. He will be re-evaluated next Wednesday. Across 10 games this season he averaged 27.8 points, 3.9 assists and 3.7 rebounds, and the Warriors were 7–3 when he was healthy.
headlines.whyItMatters: Golden State is 10–8 and in the West's middle group, so its ability to hold a spot depends heavily on Curry returning soon.

headlines.title: Heat hold on to beat Knicks 108–105 to end New York's winning streak
headlines.summary: Miami ended New York's six-game winning streak and its run as NBA Cup holders with a 108–105 win on Friday. The Knicks erased a 23-point deficit to take the lead in the fourth quarter. Jalen Brunson missed a free throw in a late sequence, and Miami held on. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and a career-high 23 rebounds, and Bam Adebayo scored 25. Karl-Anthony Towns played through an abdominal injury and finished with 19 points and 10 rebounds.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Knicks are still 12–7 and No. 5 in the East. The result also decided their Cup run, which ended on the group stage's final day.
